<quote by="Proposed: Bregasland, Seconded: Upwold">To commission a sinecure 'Reed's Roost' in Bildewold Bregasland, Self-funded. Sinecure to produce mana per season. Sinecure to create the national position 'Roost's Reeve' to be appointed by the marcher senators annually.</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a [[sinecure]] that produces mana crystals in North Fens, [[Bregasland]]
* Passed

==Date==
* Summer 386YE
==Cost==
* Standard costs apply
* 10 mithril
* 30 crowns
* Three months to complete
==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Reeds_Roost}}
==Outcome==
Now complete, the position of [[Roost's Reeve]] will be available to appoint by unanimous decision of the senators of the Marches.
